description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, PPO, and PPO+Self-reflection—across three datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, labeled “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics” in that order, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percent (%), with a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62% and tick marks at intervals of 2%. For each dataset, there are five bars representing the accuracy of each model. The “DAPO+Self-reflection” bars are blue, with heights of approximately 56.5%, 58.5%, and 61.5% for Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, respectively. The “DAPO” bars are light blue, reaching approximately 55.5%, 57.5%, and 59.5% for the same datasets. The “SRPO” bars are orange, with heights of approximately 54.5%, 55.5%, and 58.5%. The “PPO” bars are green, measuring approximately 52.5%, 54.5%, and 57.5%. Finally, the “PPO+Self-reflection” bars are striped orange and green, with heights of approximately 53.5%, 56.5%, and 60.5%. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each dataset, and are not sorted in any particular order.
